body: Owner asked 2026-11-11 ("fix all as your recommendation") after the 9i output work. Fix the three cosmetic leftovers and build the three ideas noted in docs/ideas.md. Work in worktree branch cli-output.

completion.releaseNote: `sati upgrade`, shell completions (`sati completion zsh`), and a pager for long output.
completion.summary: Added `sati upgrade` (short form of `init --upgrade --yes`, no prompt, --dry-run), `sati completion bash|zsh|fish` built from the command tree, a pager for output taller than the terminal, wrapping in `sati review`, and tab replacement in tables. Doctor and init hints name `sati upgrade`. Not built: picker for `task claim` (it already claims the top ready task). Left: stray check mark when an actor name starts with "Created" in a NO_COLOR terminal. fish completion not run.

title: CLI output follow-ups: review wrap, tick only on action lines, tabs in tables, shell completions, pager, task picker
